dict.string: BP Companion saves your blood pressure and heart rate readings to the Health app, and — when you ask — your imported YUNMAI weight history (weight, BMI, body fat, lean body mass, height).

BP Companion reads weight, BMI, body fat percentage, lean body mass and height (for example from the YUNMAI scale app) to show and analyse them in the Body tab, and your latest Apple Watch heart rate to fill in the pulse of a new reading. It does not read other health data.
